blocks.heading: Biology Eligibility Audit: 15 Doors
rows: MBBS, BDS, BAMS, BHMS, BUMS (NEET UG)

NEET eligibility names Physics, Chemistry, Biology or Biotechnology and English. An NMC public notice of 22 November 2023 allows these to be studied as additional subjects after Class 12 from a recognised board.
NMC notice via Medical Dialogues, The Federal, Business Standard
State seats are ranked on the BiPC stream of EAPCET in Telangana (PVNRTVU note). The 15 percent national quota is filled on NEET UG ranks.
Telangana and Andhra Pradesh 2026-27 notices ask for 45 percent in Physics, Chemistry, Biology and English (40 percent for reserved categories).
KNRUHS and Dr NTR UHS notifications
Admission on Class 12 PCB marks, 50 percent (40 percent for reserved categories), with NEET deferred to 2027-28.
NCAHP deferral reported by Medical Dialogues
The ICAR 2025 bulletin lists PCB, PCMB and Inter-Agriculture for this programme. PCM alone is not on the list.
Optometry, radiology, dietetics and other allied health
Reports conflict on which of these are NEET-linked from 2026-27, and colleges list their own subject lines. Treat the admitting university's notice as the only rule.

blocks.heading: B.pharm: One Course, Three State Rules
rows: The Education Regulations 2020 text for pharmacy diploma admission reads: "10+2 examination (science academic stream) with Physics, Chemistry and Biology or Mathematics." PCI's FAQ sends B.Pharm applicants to regulation 4 of the 2014 B.Pharm regulations, which I could not open, so the B.Pharm line is confirmed through state notices below.
Students from PCM or PCB schooling register with an MHT-CET 2026 or NEET 2026 score. Registration ran 31 July to 10 August 2026. PCI also allowed NIOS candidates for the first time.

AP runs a separate MPC-stream counselling for B.Pharm and Pharm.D. The 2023 round was open to MPC candidates who held or skipped an engineering seat. BiPC phase 1 in 2026 filled 10,142 of 10,958 B.Pharm seats.

Telangana ran MPC-stream web options for B.Pharm and Pharm.D on 3 and 4 September 2026, allotment by 6 September, college reporting 7 and 8 September. MPC candidates already joined in engineering could not use it. The BiPC round has 8,473 B.Pharm seats in 124 colleges.

blocks.heading: Agriculture and Food: Two Doors, Two Rules
rows: ICAR share of university seats, through CUET
Three of Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology and Agriculture. About 6,002 seats in 2025-26, roughly 20 percent of seats at the universities that use CUET and all seats at some ICAR institutes.
PCM can apply for most programmes
ANGRAU BSc (Hons) Agriculture and BTech Food Technology, Andhra Pradesh
Filled from the BiPC stream on AP EAPCET ranks. Seat counts conflict across reports (560, or 980 plus 504), so no total is quoted.
State seats (about 39) go through TG EAPCET engineering-stream counselling, and the base fee is about Rs 56,020 a year.
About 28 state seats on TG EAPCET agriculture-pharmacy ranks, base fee about Rs 56,020 a year.

blocks.heading: What Your Class 12 Combination Changes
rows: JoSAA and state B.Tech, IAT, ICAR through CUET, B.Pharm in the states that run an MPC or PCM route, NFSU, psychology, NDA, NATA, pilot training
NEET-linked seats, BSc Nursing, BPT and BOT, B.F.Sc and BiPC-only state seats, until Biology is added
PCM with Computer Science or Informatics Practices
Everything PCM opens, with a head start for BCA, BSc Computer Science and data degrees
The same list as PCM. The fourth subject adds a head start, not a new eligibility line.
PCM with Electronics or another technical fourth subject
The same list as PCM. Eligibility lines name Physics, Chemistry, Maths or Biology, not the extra subject.
PCMB, with Biology dropped before Class 12 ends
Treat yourself as PCM. Check the bulletin before assuming that a year of Class 11 Biology counts for NEET.
PCMB, with Biology kept to the end
Everything PCM opens plus every Biology-gated door
Very little. See our PCMB guide for the workload cost.

blocks.heading: Doors and Dates on 5 October 2026
rows: NIOS additional subject for the April-May 2027 exam
Applications run 1 July to 15 October 2026, which leaves 10 days from today. The October-November session opens 1 January to 15 April.
Check the dates on nios.ac.in before you pay. Do not apply before you have read the NEET bulletin question in the extra-subject section.
The bulletin is tentatively expected in February 2027 with the exam in early May. These dates are projected, not announced.
Read the eligibility clause for additional-subject candidates the day the bulletin appears.
Registration is tentatively projected for January to February 2027. ICAR UG, psychology and most BSc routes use it.
Choose domain subjects you actually studied. Maths and Physics are the usual picks for this guide's lanes.
Maharashtra registration closed on 10 August. Telangana's MPC round ended with reporting on 8 September. Andhra Pradesh's BiPC final phase reported on 24 to 26 September. Some seats remain vacant.
Ask colleges about vacant seats and fee reimbursement in writing. Do not pay an agent.
JoSAA, ICAR UG counselling, IISER counselling
All three ran their main rounds before this month. The next cycle opens through the exams listed above.
Use this autumn to prepare for the next cycle, not to chase a closed one.

blocks.heading: Claims Against the Notice
rows: "Students who have not studied Biology cannot opt for medical courses or become doctors."
Chegg India PCM guide, updated 28 September 2024

Out of date. The NMC public notice of 22 November 2023 lets candidates study Biology or Biotechnology as an additional subject after Class 12 from a recognised board and still sit NEET UG. It does not make the path easy, and counselling rules for such candidates should be checked each year.
"MPC students cannot pursue B.Pharmacy in Telangana."
Telangana ran MPC-stream web options for B.Pharm and Pharm.D on 3 and 4 September 2026, reported by Telangana Today and Deccan Chronicle.
A common claim, true in one door and false in another
ICAR admission through CUET accepts any three of Physics, Chemistry, Maths, Biology and Agriculture. ANGRAU and other state seats in Andhra Pradesh fill from the BiPC stream.
"Pilot and actuary jobs pay Rs 50 lakh a year and above."
Chegg India PCM guide; Foundit lists Rs 25 lakh product managers and a Rs 9.05 lakh data scientist average, all without a source
None of these figures has a sample size or a date. The only sample-backed numbers in this guide are in the pay table.
"Adding Biology later is a safe backup."
Pages that stop at "you are now eligible"
Eligibility is only the first filter. Half of the 720 marks are Biology, and about 20 lakh candidates sat NEET in 2026. The extra-subject route reopens the exam, not the odds.
